authority: Current founder decisions, repository specification and exact issue criteria
entries: [CATS-00 SOURCE AUTHORITY] Cats is a private browser life simulation for Russell's girlfriend, inspired by The Sims and her love of cats. Read START-HERE.md, .scratch/cats/spec.md, docs/requirements.json, docs/architecture.md, docs/contracts.md, docs/tickets.json and the exact issue before coding. The approved art is docs/art/approved-direction.png. Current founder instructions and issue additions govern stale memories. Numeric engineering defaults may be tuned with evidence; never remove a confirmed capability or weaken acceptance criteria. Public GitHub source does not make private game data or registration public.

[CATS-R01 REQUIREMENT] Browser cat household simulation: Direct a household of cats with personalities and free will. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R02 REQUIREMENT] All play pillars: Personalities/drama, building/decorating, and care/goals/progression are all core. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R03 REQUIREMENT] Cat antics and whimsical lives: Real feline behavior alongside hobbies, adventures, goals, careers, and romance. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R04 REQUIREMENT] Phone and computer parity: Phone and computer are equally important; core actions work on both. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R05 REQUIREMENT] Approved art: Use the approved A + B image: pastel cartoon cats and furnishings, overhead cutaway home, pixel-detailed neighborhood. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R06 REQUIREMENT] Full house building: Build rooms, walls, doors and decorate with furniture, colors and cat furnishings. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R07 REQUIREMENT] Real and fictional cats: Recreate real cats and create or adopt fictional cats, with names, looks and personalities. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R08 REQUIREMENT] Death and permanent loss: Death and permanent loss are explicitly in scope; do not restore the superseded no-death boundary. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R09 REQUIREMENT] Pause when closed: No simulation time, aging, needs decay or death while the game is closed. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R10 REQUIREMENT] Automatic synced saves: Continue the same household automatically between computer and phone. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R11 REQUIREMENT] Private gift: Game access is for her and testing; public source does not authorize public gameplay registration. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R12 REQUIREMENT] Money and unlocks: Earn game money and unlock content in normal play. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R13 REQUIREMENT] Optional free-build: Offer optional free-build alongside earned progression. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R14 REQUIREMENT] Careers: Scheduled careers with skills and promotions. Cats wear clothes relating to their careers when they go off to work. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R15 REQUIREMENT] Hobbies and businesses: Hobbies and little businesses are also income sources. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R16 REQUIREMENT] Moo-Moo terminology: Call the action exactly Moo-Moo. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R17 REQUIREMENT] Mutual readiness: Cats must be in love, aligned, and in the mood; player input cannot override the other cat. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R18 REQUIREMENT] Autonomous and directed: Moo-Moo can be initiated by cats or suggested by the player. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R19 REQUIREMENT] Chance of kittens: Moo-Moo carries a chance of kittens, not a guaranteed pregnancy. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R20 REQUIREMENT] Eight-cat capacity: Maximum eight living household cats, including kittens. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R21 REQUIREMENT] Moo-Moo at capacity: At eight cats, Moo-Moo remains available but cannot initiate a new pregnancy. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R22 REQUIREMENT] Memorial and ghosts: Death creates a memorial; occasional ghost visits do not resurrect the cat. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R23 REQUIREMENT] Fixed lifespan: Pace between normal and slow; no adjustable lifespan setting. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R24 REQUIREMENT] One neighborhood: One lively playable neighborhood with homes, café, park, shops and other cats. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-R25 REQUIREMENT] Included picture: Include the exact approved image in the model handoff and repository. Confirmed product scope, not optional polish. Source: docs/requirements.json and .scratch/cats/spec.md. Preserve it throughout all affected vertical slices.

[CATS-T01 ISSUE #2] Create and resume a private saved household. Deliver: An invited player signs in, names a household, saves it to real storage, and resumes it after signing out. Acceptance: Reject uninvited, expired-session and cross-owner reads/writes on every server endpoint. Double-tapping Create makes one household; stable identity and name survive reload. Provision isolated real development auth/database before SDK wiring; do not replace them with production demo data. Deliver usable desktop and phone entry, loading, retry and sign-out states. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/01-private-household.md and plan Task 1. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T02 ISSUE #3] Select and move an animated cat in the approved world. Deliver: Open a rendered home, select a cat, and move it around furniture by touch or mouse. Acceptance: Use separate sprites, tiles, collision and controls; the approved picture is never the playable background. Selection updates a DOM cat panel and movement follows reachable paths without teleporting through objects. Pan, zoom, selection, cancel and pointer-cancel work on desktop and phone without hover-only actions. Position persists, unreachable paths explain failure, and renderer loss offers recovery. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 01. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/02-playable-home.md and plan Task 2. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T03 ISSUE #4] Resume safely across devices and pause while away. Deliver: Automatically save, switch devices and resume without doubled time or competing writers. Acceptance: Enforce one writer with server-issued lease epoch, TTL, renewal and explicit takeover; reject stale writers. Use revision CAS and request idempotency; a lost response retried after commit cannot write twice. Pause on close, hidden tab, lost lease or connectivity loss; no wall-clock catch-up after resuming. Retain a local conflict recovery copy and show Saving/Saved/Reconnecting honestly. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 01, 02. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/03-sync-and-pause.md and plan Task 3. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T04 ISSUE #5] Create real or imaginary cats. Deliver: Create named cats with visible coats, body details and personality traits, then save them. Acceptance: Creator inventory supports real-cat recreation and fictional cats; preview changes affect sprite and portrait. Enforce eight living cats plus reserved unborn slots; ninth creation changes nothing. Support Unicode names, reject blank/unsafe input, and keep phone keyboard from obscuring confirmation. Persist canonical appearance/trait IDs and migrate safely if a catalog entry changes. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 02, 03. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/04-cat-creator.md and plan Task 4. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T05 ISSUE #6] Feed, rest, play and care for cats. Deliver: Use real objects to satisfy hunger, energy, fun, social, hygiene and bladder needs. Acceptance: Each action navigates, reserves an anchor, animates, takes simulation time and applies an observable need effect. Queue, cancel and interrupted/removed/occupied targets release reservations and unused resources. Bowl, bed, toy, litter and grooming objects all work end to end and persist their state. Paused/closed games do not decay needs; UI rendering never advances simulation time. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 02, 03. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/05-care.md and plan Task 5. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T06 ISSUE #7] Watch personalities and free will shape behavior. Deliver: Unselected cats independently choose care, social actions, play, naps and mischief. Acceptance: Use trait/need utility, seeded tie-breaks and cooldowns; persist RNG and current action. Different traits produce distinguishable choices in an observable multi-cat fixture. Prevent oscillation, starvation loops, double-reserved objects and endless unreachable-route attempts. Player suggestions use the same domain validation; refusals are visible and do not coerce another cat. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 04, 05. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/06-autonomy.md and plan Task 6. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T07 ISSUE #8] Buy, place, recolor, move, rotate and sell furniture. Deliver: Decorate the real home with functional objects paid for using household money. Acceptance: Touch and mouse support preview, rotate, confirm, cancel, move, sell and authored color/style variants. Validate footprints, wall/door overlap, anchors and walkability before an atomic debit and placement. Insufficient funds, occupied objects and rejected edits give reasons; retries never double-charge. Changed layouts persist and cats actually use moved furniture. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 05. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/07-furniture.md and plan Task 7. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T08 ISSUE #9] Build the floor plan, rooms and finishes. Deliver: Create and reshape rooms with walls, doors, windows, floor finishes and wall colors. Acceptance: Allow editing the home lot topology rather than decorating fixed rooms. Preview and atomically commit itemized build costs; invalid geometry or funds restore exact prior state. Recompute room boundaries, occlusion, anchors and paths after edits. Provide explicit touch start/end/confirm controls and equivalent keyboard/mouse workflow. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 07. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/08-floor-plan.md and plan Task 8. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T09 ISSUE #10] Undo and demolish without trapping cats. Deliver: Pause to build, undo/redo within a build session, and safely resume household activity. Acceptance: Reject walls on cats, stranded entrances and inaccessible required/occupied anchors with a visible highlight. Cancel restores the whole transaction; undo/redo includes geometry and cost. Invalidate routes after edits; resuming replans against the current topology. Undo cannot cross a live simulation/save epoch, restore a dead cat or duplicate money/items. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 08. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/09-safe-edits.md and plan Task 9. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T10 ISSUE #11] Offer free-build without money exploits. Deliver: Opt into free decorating, then return to normal earned progression. Acceptance: Free-build changes build cost/catalog access only; it does not disable needs, age or death. Free objects have persistent provenance and zero resale; free demolition gives no normal refund. Free placement never grants earned goals/unlocks; leaving mode does not charge retroactively. Mode and pending edits survive safe reload, and its effect is clearly visible. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 07, 09. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/10-free-build.md and plan Task 10. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T11 ISSUE #12] Paint, improve and sell artwork. Deliver: Use an easel to grow painting skill and create art that can be displayed or sold. Acceptance: Work duration, skill and seeded quality produce a real persistent artwork. Cancel or loss of the easel preserves partial progress without duplication. Display creates a placeable artwork; idempotent sale removes it and credits exactly once. Skill, product provenance and work-in-progress survive device switch. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 05, 07. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/11-painting.md and plan Task 11. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T12 ISSUE #13] Grow, harvest and sell produce. Deliver: Buy seeds, plant, water, harvest and sell three distinct crops. Acceptance: Growth and withering use simulation time; nothing advances while away. Care affects yield; harvest puts real products into inventory. Handle missing tools, occupied beds, full inventory and removed plants without losing unrelated items. Purchase/harvest/sale retries cannot duplicate products or make funds negative. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 05, 07. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/12-gardening.md and plan Task 12. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T13 ISSUE #14] Work scheduled careers and earn promotions. Deliver: Choose among three careers, attend shifts, earn wages and advance through three ranks. Acceptance: Each track defines schedules, skill criteria, wages and explicit promotion requirements. Departure, attendance, return and payment are real saved activities, with wages issued once. Handle lateness, low needs, job changes, dismissal, interruption and death without phantom pay. Career UI explains progress on phone and desktop; off-camera work shares the paused world clock. Cats automatically wear a distinct outfit matching their career at departure and during work; return, cancellation and job change restore the ordinary look without changing coat/accessories, and mid-shift saves preserve the correct outfit. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 05, 11. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/13-careers.md and plan Task 13. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T14 ISSUE #15] Complete goals and unlock content. Deliver: Track meaningful care, building, skill and career goals and earn rewards. Acceptance: Show prerequisite and progress for each goal and locked item. Rewards key off domain achievements and are granted once across retries/devices. Free-build actions do not counterfeit earned goals; rewards cannot be claimed repeatedly. Register later social, family, business and neighborhood goals under the same event contract. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 07, 11, 12, 13. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/14-goals.md and plan Task 14. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T15 ISSUE #16] Travel to a lively persistent neighborhood. Deliver: Leave home, visit the park and see other cats while the household continues off-camera. Acceptance: Connect home, park, residential homes, shop and café using actual navigable routes. Travel takes simulation time and can fail/cancel with recovery; return preserves state. Off-camera household activity uses one shared clock, not duplicate independent simulation loops. NPC identities, routines, traits and locations persist instead of respawning each visit. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 06, 09. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/15-neighborhood.md and plan Task 15. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T16 ISSUE #17] Shop and visit neighborhood homes. Deliver: Enter shops, buy goods and visit other cats at home. Acceptance: Purchases commit stock, inventory and funds together. Hours, invitations/access and object permissions govern entry and use. Visiting NPC homes does not grant build ownership; all mutation commands check lot ownership. Closed shops, depleted stock, capacity, interrupted travel and insufficient money have actionable states. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 15, 07. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/16-shops-visits.md and plan Task 16. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T17 ISSUE #18] Develop friendships, rivalries and memories. Deliver: Socialize with household and neighborhood cats, forming persistent bonds and rivalries. Acceptance: Implement initiation, recipient response, animations, cooldown and mood/relationship effects. Friendship/rivalry meaningfully changes autonomous behavior. Show known cats and memorable events in an accessible relationship panel. Move-out, death, cancellation and scene transitions retain identities and avoid dangling references. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 06, 15. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/17-friendships.md and plan Task 17. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T18 ISSUE #19] Fall in love with mutual readiness. Deliver: Adult cats develop mutual romantic bonds and accept or decline affection. Acceptance: Reciprocal affection is required; one-sided affection is not mutual love. Check age, family links, health, needs, mood, availability and pair cooldown for both cats. Player and autonomous proposals use the same eligibility function at execution time. Declines explain why, respect cooldown and cannot trigger a pregnancy roll. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 17. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/18-romance.md and plan Task 18. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T19 ISSUE #20] Moo-Moo, chance pregnancy and safe birth. Deliver: Willing cats in love can Moo-Moo and sometimes conceive and later welcome kittens. Acceptance: Use exactly Moo-Moo; keep its presentation discreet and non-graphic. Player or cats may initiate, but both must be willing/in love/in mood at start and completion. Roll conception once per completed eligible action with persisted seeded RNG; declined/canceled attempts never roll. At eight occupied/reserved spaces Moo-Moo still works without pregnancy; at seven a new litter reserves at most one slot. Reserve litter size at conception; creation, adoption and simultaneous conception share capacity checks; birth atomically exchanges slots for kittens. Persist pregnancy, parents, due time, RNG and birth idempotency; retries, reload and interruptions cannot duplicate kittens. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 18, 04. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/19-moo-moo.md and plan Task 19. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T20 ISSUE #21] Raise kittens and follow generations. Deliver: Name and care for kittens, see inherited looks/traits and navigate the family tree. Acceptance: Store both parent identities, inheritance and life stage even after death or move-out. Kitten care and animations work; kittens cannot work, romance or Moo-Moo. Family tree distinguishes living, deceased and moved-out members and prevents close-relative romance. Handle pregnancy-carrier death and interrupted birth with released reservations and no orphaned state. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 19, 05. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/20-kittens-family.md and plan Task 20. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T21 ISSUE #22] Age at a fixed pace and face old age. Deliver: Progress through kitten, adolescent, adult and elder stages on one moderately relaxed lifespan. Acceptance: Use documented fixed durations; no lifespan selector or aging setting. Only active simulation advances age; elder milestones give notice of old-age death. Death is once-only and stops work/actions/romance, releases living capacity and preserves history. If the last cat dies, keep the house/save and offer adoption rather than resetting. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 20, 13. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/21-aging.md and plan Task 21. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T22 ISSUE #23] Treat illness and respond to danger. Deliver: Illness, severe neglect and a kitchen-fire accident can be treated or lead to permanent death. Acceptance: Symptoms and warnings precede consequences; offer meaningful treatment/rescue rather than unavoidable per-frame death rolls. Interventions change outcomes through actual cost, action duration, world state and save behavior. Closed/hidden games never advance hazard timers; recovery cancels the matching pending event. Concurrent causes create one death record and do not duplicate memorials or clear unrelated state. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 21, 05. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/22-health-hazards.md and plan Task 22. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T23 ISSUE #24] Memorialize cats and receive ghost visits. Deliver: Place memorials, read memories and receive occasional visits from deceased cats. Acceptance: Create one memorial per death and preserve it when moved/stored. Ghost chance and visit cooldown use simulation nights and seeded RNG. Ghosts remain deceased, consume no living slots, cannot work/conceive and never restore life. Reload does not duplicate a visit; living cats can react and family history remains intact. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 21, 17. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/23-ghosts.md and plan Task 23. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T24 ISSUE #25] Own and operate a cat café. Deliver: Buy the café business, stock it, serve orders and earn net profit. Acceptance: Implement ownership, hours, supplies, three recipes/products, customer orders, service and a profit summary. Revenue subtracts actual stock/costs; no infinite free customers or repeated order payouts. Handle closure, absent/dead owner, low needs, empty stock and interrupted orders. Customer identities, reputation, ledger and idempotent order settlement persist across devices. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 11, 13, 16, 17. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/24-cafe.md and plan Task 24. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T25 ISSUE #26] Adopt and move adult cats to neighborhood homes. Deliver: Adopt when there is space or let an adult move out while retaining its identity and relationships. Acceptance: Preview adoption and confirm before atomic funds/capacity changes, counting unborn reservations. Move-out is a confirmed transfer to a residence with a slot, not deletion; the cat remains visitable. Defer pregnant-cat transfer until birth with a clear explanation; do not cancel pregnancy silently. Adoption after last-cat death continues the existing home, money, memories and neighborhood. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 04, 15, 20, 21. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/25-adoption-move-out.md and plan Task 25. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T26 ISSUE #27] Make the private gift welcoming and understandable. Deliver: Guide her through play, let her personalize cats and dedication, and control sound. Acceptance: Provide a skippable/resumable tutorial for select, care, build, relationships and saves. Do not invent her name or real-cat identities; editable profiles are usable without missing personal details. Sound starts after interaction with music/effects controls, mute and reduced-motion support. Isolate tester saves; reset requires specific confirmation and a recovery snapshot. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 04, 05, 14, 19, 25. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/26-gift-onboarding.md and plan Task 26. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T27 ISSUE #28] Complete coherent game art and content. Deliver: Furnish and play the whole world using the complete initial functional catalog and consistent animation. Acceptance: Meet the spec content inventory: creator choices, object functions/variants, locations, NPCs, crops, careers, recipes and goals. Every item has stable ID, icon, footprint, interaction anchors, cost and runtime assets; no dead buttons or missing textures. Produce clean consistent sprites/tiles/animation from approved direction; record provenance and manifest hashes. Inspect all affected desktop and phone states against the approved picture without using the picture as production scenery. Provide distinct career clothing assets and world/portrait animations for work departure, shift and return, readable on phone and desktop and driven by saved career state. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 07, 08, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 19, 23, 24. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/27-art-content.md and plan Task 27. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T28 ISSUE #29] Finish all controls for touch, keyboard and mouse. Deliver: Complete every care/build/social/business action on phones and computers comfortably. Acceptance: Portrait/landscape safe areas, keyboard, dialogs and HUD do not hide confirm/cancel or selected cat. Use 44px targets, readable text, focus management, non-color status cues and DOM alternatives to canvas actions. Pinch, pan, panel scroll and pointer cancellation never commit build or social actions accidentally. Open every captured state and fix clipping, overlap, missing stacking and horizontal overflow before acceptance. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 10, 16, 19, 24, 26, 27. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/28-mobile-accessibility.md and plan Task 28. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T29 ISSUE #30] Survive migrations, corruption and interrupted saves. Deliver: Upgrade and recover existing households without silent resets or lost generations. Acceptance: Version/validate complete state, catalog references, RNG, action queues, family, deaths and businesses. Migrations are deterministic and transactional with immutable pre-migration backup; future versions are rejected. Checksum, revision and epoch conflicts show named recovery copies without overwriting the winning cloud save. Export/import is recovery only; it safely remaps imported ownership and IDs and preserves invariants. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 03, 19, 21, 24. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/29-save-recovery.md and plan Task 29. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T30 ISSUE #31] Balance a complete household lifetime. Deliver: Play a complete saga of care, building, work, love, kittens, danger, death and legacy. Acceptance: Run deterministic long-duration scenarios and record money, needs, population, pregnancies and mortality. Early sessions and unlocks are attainable; care/treatment budgets are sustainable without infinite-profit exploits. Exercise simultaneous conception/adoption/death/reload against the eight-slot invariant across seeded runs. Tune engineering defaults using measurements while retaining all confirmed scope and fixed lifespan intent. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 14, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 27, 29. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/30-lifetime-balance.md and plan Task 30. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T31 ISSUE #32] Blind-review and dogfood the complete game. Deliver: Independently verify every requirement, the art direction, security and real phone/desktop play. Acceptance: Map every requirement/story to passing behavior tests or reviewed manual evidence on the exact commit. Dogfood Chrome/Safari desktop and mobile Safari/Chrome, including real-device smoke and cross-device resume. Measure full-content scene frame times, input delay, initial load, bounded memory trend and save payload. Verify private access, owner isolation, writer fencing, no secrets, no production fixtures and no untested visible actions. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 28, 30. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/31-whole-game-verification.md and plan Task 31. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-T32 ISSUE #33] Release the verified private gift. Deliver: Deploy privately and verify the accepted game with a rollback path and recipient handoff. Acceptance: Require green CI, independent review, viewed desktop/mobile screenshots and complete requirement coverage. Verify the exact deployment/commit, private access, asset load, unauthorized rejection and cross-device persistence. Do real recipient sign-in/device acceptance when identity/devices are available; otherwise explicitly report that remaining gate. Do not send external invitations/messages under Russell's name without explicit authorization; prepare enrollment and private link. Needs integration evidence from Tasks 31. Source: .scratch/cats/issues/32-private-release.md and plan Task 32. Original issue closes only after real UI/domain/persistence/failure states, desktop+phone dogfood and independent blind review.

[CATS-C01 FLOW] Build a connected cat life simulation with full household autonomy and player direction: care, personality drama, house building/decorating, earned goals, relationships, generations, neighborhood travel and livelihoods all affect one persistent world. Never simplify the requested game into a clicker, fixed house, static art demo or disconnected mini-games.

[CATS-C02 ART] Approved A+B: pastel cartoon cats and furnishings, overhead cutaway home, pixel-detailed neighborhood. View docs/art/approved-direction.png before art/UI work. Make modular original sprites/tiles/portraits and expressive animations; do not paste the reference picture as gameplay. Keep cats readable and cute, house welcoming and phone HUD spacious.

[CATS-C03 CONTROLS] Computer and phone are equally important. Every core action must work with touch, keyboard and mouse. Minimum44px touch controls, safe areas, no hover-only actions or horizontal overflow. Check390x844 and360px narrow phone plus desktop. Real canvas picking/pan/zoom/build interaction and accessible DOM alternatives are both required.

[CATS-C04 CLOCK] Fixed-step active simulation only. Initial tuning1real second=1sim minute,1day=1440sim minutes. Clamp foreground frame delta to250ms. Discard hidden-tab/closed/offline/lease-conflict time; never catch up on resume. Needs, aging, pregnancies, careers, travel, hazards, crops and customers all share this clock.

[CATS-C05 RNG] Use one persisted seeded RNG state and stable event sequence. Identical prior state plus commands/time produces identical results; reload/retry cannot reroll luck. Validate commands before drawing. Declined or capacity-full Moo-Moo never draws conception RNG. Test replay, frame segmentation and no mutation on rejection.

[CATS-C06 MOO-MOO] The exact player-facing term is Moo-Moo. Both autonomy and player suggestion invoke the same mutual adult/in-love/aligned/willing/mood checks. A player cannot force the partner. Non-graphic romantic action completes before conception chance. Default25%; on success draw litter1-3 once and clamp to available slots, reserve immediately. Gestation default3sim days. No duplicate conception on retry.

[CATS-C07 CAPACITY] Hard limit8living household cats including kittens. Available capacity=8-living-reserved litter slots. Birth atomically swaps reserved slots for kittens. Pregnancy, adoption, transfers and simultaneous births all share this invariant. At capacity Moo-Moo remains available with no new pregnancy. Ghosts and deceased cats are never living capacity.

[CATS-C08 LIFESPAN] Founder fixed pace between normal and slow, not adjustable. Engineering default150sim days split10kitten,20adolescent,95adult,25elder. This tuning is not a new founder preference; measure against household-lifetime playtests. Never add a player lifespan/speed option that defeats the chosen pace.

[CATS-C09 DEATH] Death/permanent loss is explicitly allowed. Preventable hazards/illness require visible warnings and intervention windows; closed game cannot harm cats. Death cancels actions/jobs/payments, preserves genealogy/identity/history, releases living capacity and creates a memorial. Occasional ghosts are memorial projections, never resurrected cats. Last-cat death retains house, wallet and memorials and supports new adoption.

[CATS-C10 MONEY] Earned money/unlocks coexist with optional free-build. Track provenance on items/build edits. Free-created value has zero earned resale/refund/reward and cannot mint progress through undo/redo, cancellation, transfer or recovery. Money operations are bounded, atomic and exactly once. Work, painting, crops and café stay real income loops in normal mode.

[CATS-C11 CONTENT] Initial engineering inventory:3careers (Café Assistant,Garden Keeper,Gallery Helper),3ranks each;2hobbies Painting/Gardening;3canonical crops tomato/strawberry/catnip;1ownable café with3recipes;8named fictional NPC cats;7lots (home,3NPC homes,park,shop,café);30functional furnishing/decor IDs;18named goals. Every item needs stable ID, price, unlocks, footprint/anchors, icon and working action.

[CATS-C12 CAREER CLOTHES] Founder added2026-09-20: cats wear clothes related to their careers when going to work. Distinct outfits automatically appear at departure/while working and ordinary look returns on return/cancel/job change. Suggested defaults café apron,gardener overalls/sunhat,gallery smock/beret. Preserve coat/accessories. World sprites AND portraits show saved career outfit correctly after reload/device resume. State owner=economy; renderer owner=world.

[CATS-C13 PERSONALIZATION] Real-cat recreation and imaginary cat creation/adoption both matter. Names, coats, body/pattern/eyes, accessories and personalities must be editable in game. Do not invent the girlfriend's name or real-cat identities. Synthetic sample cats are explicitly fictional. Recipient-specific confirmation lives in issue35 and editable gift/onboarding settings.

[CATS-C14 PRIVACY] Private allowlisted gift/test identities only. Public repository does not authorize public registration or public saves. Server derives authenticated subject, checks private membership and household owner on EVERY route, including before returning idempotent receipts. Client actorId/ownerId is never authority. Real dev/test auth/database; no production recipient data as fixtures or secrets in logs/source.

[CATS-C15 SAVE PROTOCOL] Automatic same-save phone/computer. Server cloud writes use revision CAS, request idempotency and single writer lease with monotonic fencing epoch. Default lease30s, renew before half-life; takeover after expiry invalidates old writer. Duplicate requestId+same payload returns stored receipt, differing payload is rejected; owner check comes first. Transactions prevent lost updates.

[CATS-C16 LOCAL RECOVERY] IndexedDB stores confirmed snapshot plus bounded local recovery branch. Network failure pauses game. Reconnect acquires/validates lease and revision before resume. Conflicting local state is preserved for explicit recovery/discard; never silently overwrite newest cloud. Corrupt/unknown-schema saves are quarantined, checksummed, backed up and migrated by numbered forward migrations.

[CATS-C17 ARCHITECTURE] Proposed stack Next AppRouter/TypeScript/React DOM+Pixi8, headless domain, IndexedDB, verified auth/Postgres and deployment. Verify actual installed APIs; technical defaults may change with evidence without losing behavior. No runtime AI/model API. Public commands enter dispatch, time enters advance, UI reads selectView. Renderer/React effects must not mutate simulation.

[CATS-C18 MODULE ATOMICITY] Subsystems must support cross-system atomic changes: building debits wallet, conception reserves household capacity, birth creates cats. Current integration ruling uses immutable full WorldState reducers plus typed command unions/discriminators/initializer/tick exports, composed by core owner. Do not return only local subsystem state or duplicate central schema in each lane. See work/orchestrator/parallel-contract.md on integration branch while build is active.

[CATS-C19 TEST SEAM] openScenario(page,name) returns {householdId:string}; ignore stale void-return declaration. Test-only server fixture registry uses dedicated synthetic identity and real DB, sets initial data once and opens real game. Production must not expose fixture handlers/query bypasses. Reload/new context never reseeds state. Tests exercise real controls and persisted effects, not labels or mocked success.

[CATS-C20 COMMITTED VIEW] Authenticated owner-checked GET /api/households/[id]/view reads latest COMMITTED cloud snapshot through production selectView and returns revision/checksum/view. It accepts no expected fixture results and never reads browser state. Pause and await cloud acknowledgement before checksum assertions. A fresh browser context must see identical saved facts.

[CATS-C21 QUALITY] Every issue/spec/PR is dogfooded against intended request, approved art, whole-game mission, meaningful UX and regressions, then independently blind-reviewed without author rationale. Never weaken acceptance criteria to match a partial implementation, close tickets administratively or call a pure module a complete vertical slice.

[CATS-C22 SCREENSHOT EVIDENCE] Every PR includes screenshots: affected desktop/phone before/after for UI, actual passing-verification capture for non-UI. OPEN AND LOOK at each screenshot, describe state and fix clipped labels, overlaps, missing stacking and overflow. Screenshot existence alone is not visual inspection. Local, preview, merged and live evidence stay distinct.

[CATS-C23 GAUNTLET] Codex orchestrates quality checks. Frozen whole-game bar requires all hard criteria and independent behavior/security, visual/UX and whole-game/regression lenses. Final visual acceptance requires deterministic independent current-build capture and100/100 reviewers in two consecutive valid rounds. Compare duplicate runtime captures for determinism; the generative art image is direction, not a pixel-identical gameplay screenshot. No invented real-device/recipient acceptance.

Keep explicit file ownership, real dependencies and integration safety; never duplicate the same work to consume capacity. Implement autonomously, do not stop to ask whether to proceed. Maintain progress and preserve peer changes; no shared stash or pattern kills.
